name: KXM Agent Skills Suite
description: Comprehensive suite of agent skills covering all KXM top-level commands

skills.name: kxm
skills.intent: Select the right suite skill; state universal safety rules and portable CLI convention

skills.name: kxm-project-setup
skills.intent: Initialize, migrate, review permission changes, configure, and add shell completion

skills.name: kxm-harness-auth
skills.intent: Inspect authenticated harness capability and operate supported runtimes/workers without inventing fallback

skills.name: kxm-hub-ops
skills.intent: Run and protect the local hub and its durable SQLite state

skills.name: kxm-session
skills.intent: Resume/inspect operator work and use only the UI capabilities each harness actually supports

skills.name: kxm-peer
skills.intent: Discover, send, poll/await, cancel, fan out, inbox, and reply safely

skills.name: kxm-workflow
skills.intent: Operate webhook workflows, waits/signals, evidence checkpoints, provenance, and deterministic gates

skills.name: kxm-definitions
skills.intent: Manage role and workflow definitions through their configuration authority without permission expansion

skills.name: kxm-runs
skills.intent: Create and inspect local vNext runs while preserving current execution-status boundaries

skills.name: kxm-context-memory
skills.intent: Query role-aware context and manage Git-authored memory proposals without treating proposals as authority

skills.name: kxm-skill-lifecycle
skills.intent: Govern candidate/evaluate/promote/quarantine/reject/verify lifecycle; distinguish this from bundled skills

skills.name: kxm-routing-improve
skills.intent: Inspect real route quality/cost and propose reviewed improvements without auto-routing or underquoting

skills.name: kxm-tasks
skills.intent: Recommend workflows and manage goals/tasks with explicit SCM/tracker boundaries
